verdict.line: You lose if Darius lands a Flash-less Apprehend (E) all-in before level 6; from 6 onward your tentacle network and R turn his engages into free damage, matching the measured 56.3% win rate over 32 games.

brief.thesis: Illaoi wins this lane long-run (56.3% WR, 32 games, lane and solo-kill edge per OP.GG) because her tentacle network punishes exactly the close-quarters stacking Darius needs to win a trade. The catch is a hard structural weak point: before level 6 she has no tentacles up yet, so a Q (Decimate) wind-up into E (Apprehend) pull without Flash can simply kill her outright.

theirWindow.what: Darius winds up Q (Decimate) then uses E (Apprehend, 535 range) to pull you in with no tentacles to punish it — OP.GG flags this as a near-death scenario without Flash. Hold outside 535 range and farm with Q (Tentacle Smash) until you've landed an E (Test of Spirit) near a wall or your Flash is up.

yourWindow.what: Apprehend's cooldown is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — once it's spent, he has no way to force the fight onto his terms. Walk up and W (Harsh Lesson, 4s cooldown) onto him so nearby Tentacles swing too, stacking free damage and healing while he can't pull you back out.

start.why: Highest-picked start in this matchup (58.1% pick, 56% WR over 25 games) — the extra damage and sustain let you actually punish him once your tentacles are up instead of just surviving.

boots.why: 70.7% pick and best-performing boots (51.7% over 29 games) — flattens the repeated autos he needs to stack Hemorrhage to 5 and trigger his enrage.

core.why: Stacks off your Q/W/R spam and shreds armor, directly offsetting the armor he ignores passively through Apprehend.
The slow on cast locks him in place right after your W (Harsh Lesson) leap, so your tentacles and allies get a free follow-up window.
HP and a damage-reduction shield to survive the burst window if he does land a 5-stack Hemorrhage all-in.

situational.when: he's building toward a heavy heal/lifesteal path alongside his Q (Decimate) healing
he's snowballed ahead and you need to delay his burst to get your own damage off
he's stacking crit or attack speed and repeatedly re-engaging with autos

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror ramps during the extended Test of Spirit and tentacle trades Illaoi forces, giving bonus AD and healing that directly offsets Darius's passive bleed sustain in a prolonged fight.

summoners.why: Highest win rate and pick rate combo (60% WR, 58.1% pick) — Flash is mandatory to dodge the pre-6 Apprehend pull OP.GG flags as lethal, and Teleport lets you reset the wave after you win a trade.

playing.title: Respect E pull pre-6
playing.detail: Keep spacing outside 535 range and don't commit to trades unless your Flash is up or he's already used Apprehend — this is the one window where he can outright kill you.

playing.title: Seed tentacles off terrain early
playing.detail: Use E (Test of Spirit) near jungle walls and lane terrain as soon as it's up so you have Tentacles ready before his first real all-in window.

playing.title: W into every trade
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson is only a 4s cooldown and leaps you onto him while making nearby Tentacles swing too — use it on cooldown once tentacles are placed.

playing.title: All-in with R at 6
playing.detail: Leap of Faith spawns a Tentacle for every champion hit, so landing it on him the moment you hit level 6 turns the fight immediately in your favor.

playing.title: Track his Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: At 5 stacks he enrages with a big AD spike and his R (Noxian Guillotine) deals bonus true damage — disengage or finish the trade before he reaches max stacks.

playing.title: Shred with Black Cleaver first
playing.detail: Rushing Cleaver before Iceborn lets your stacked armor shred offset the armor penetration his Apprehend passive already grants him.

playing.title: Don't duel into his Q blade
playing.detail: Even after landing your E (Test of Spirit), fall back if he closes in — standing in his Decimate's blade zone is the single biggest damage spike he has.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the lane timing reads, power-curve calls, and trade patterns are my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: A pre-level 6 Illaoi will most likely be killed if she is pulled by Darius’s (E) if you do not use Flash. Try to stay outside the range of (E) and farm with your [Q]. Even after you strike him with [E], fall back if Darius closes in to use (E). If you must engage in close quarters, be careful not to stay in range of his (Q).
